You don't need a perfect CV. You need the right skills.
This is not a role that filters by job title or tenure. It filters by what you can actually do.
We are looking for a recruiter who owns the full process — from the first Boolean search string to the signed offer, without
hand-holding, without process gaps, and without needing someone to define the search for them.
Skills are the filter, not biography. If you can demonstrate the capabilities below, we want to hear from you, regardless of how
your career path looks on paper.

You will be the driving force behind talent acquisition at a fast-growing, AI-powered HR Tech startup based in Berlin. This is an
internal recruiting role, not a staffing agency seat, not a volume-first environment.
You will own the complete hiring funnel: sharpen the role before searching, build and execute sourcing strategies, conduct
structured interviews, and manage stakeholders who need to be challenged, not just served.
Roles are thought of in terms of skill requirements, not job titles. The result is precision instead of volume. That's the standard
you'll work within and the standard you'll be held to.

A coordinator position waiting for candidates to come in
A reactive sourcing seat with no strategic mandate
A bureaucratic HR function with fixed playbooks and no autonomy

Full ownership of the recruiting process from identification to signed offer
A strategic partner seat, you challenge requirements, you advise, you deliver
A skill-first environment where your process quality matters more than your job title history
Your Skill Map
Core Skills are the central, non-negotiable capabilities of the role. Extended Skills are desirable additional competencies that
strengthen the profile but are not a knockout criterion.
Core Skills - KO Level
These are non-negotiable. If you cannot demonstrate these, this role is not a match.
Full-Cycle Recruiting Ownership
You independently drive the complete hiring process, from role clarification and sourcing strategy through structured
assessment to offer and close — without process gaps or handoffs mid-funnel.
What we look for: You can describe a search you ran end-to-end, including how you aligned the hiring manager on
requirements before searching, how you structured the funnel, and how you navigated blockers.
Active Sourcing via LinkedIn Recruiter
You can build and execute complex Boolean search strings from scratch, not just apply standard filters. You understand
how to construct multi-layer queries, use operators, and adapt strings to market signals.
What we look for: You can write a Boolean string for a target role live, explain the logic behind it, and describe how you would
adapt it if initial results are too narrow or too broad.
Competency-Based Interviewing
You conduct structured interviews using a defined competency framework. Your candidate assessments are evidencebased, documented, and defensible, not impressionistic.
What we look for: You can explain how you assess a specific competency in an interview, what question structure you use, and
how you document the evidence. You distinguish between self-reported claims and demonstrated behavior.
Stakeholder Advisory
You challenge hiring managers when role definitions are unrealistic, market expectations are off, or process decisions
create risk. You align before searching, not after.
What we look for: You can describe a situation where you pushed back on a hiring manager's position and explain how you
built the case and navigated the outcome.
Data-Driven Recruiting
You read, interpret, and act on funnel KPIs, time-to-hire, source-to-screen conversion, offer acceptance rates. You use
data to make process decisions, not just report them.
What we look for: You can describe a recruiting funnel metric you tracked, how you interpreted it, and what process change it
drove.
Language Skills — Non-Negotiable
German at C2 / native-equivalent level, required for candidate conversations, stakeholder communication, and process
documentation in a German-speaking context. English at C1+ level, required for written and verbal communication in an
international team environment.
AGG note: Both language requirements are professionally justified by the candidate-facing and client-facing nature of the role
Strong Skills - Valued, Not KO
These strengthen your application but will not exclude you if absent.
Talent Pool Architecture: You systematically build, segment, and maintain candidate pipelines for recurring roles, not ad hoc lists
AI & Tech Tool Affinity: You have hands-on experience with modern ATS systems and AI-assisted sourcing or matching tools
Employer Branding Contribution: You can co-create job ad copy, LinkedIn content, or employer brand messaging, not just distribute it
Startup / Scale-Up Navigation: You have delivered results in environments where process, structure, and resources were all still being built
What You'll Work With
AI-powered recruiting infrastructure: The team you'll join builds and operates its own recruiting tooling. You will use it daily.
Modern ATS environment: Structured pipelines, documented stages, KPI tracking built in
LinkedIn Recruiter: Including Recruiter Lite or full seat, depending on search volume
Direct collaboration with a small, senior team, no layers, short decision paths
A technology-first environment where manual workarounds are the exception, not the norm
The operating model follows a clear sequence: first understand, then structure, then automate. Everyone working here works not in individual cases, but within a system.
What's On Offer
Hybrid working model: Berlin base, flexible execution
Real ownership: You design and run your own processes within a clear framework, no micromanagement
Direct access to decision-makers: No approval chains for sourcing decisions or outreach copy
Growth context: You are part of building the internal recruiting capability, not maintaining a legacy setup
Purpose-driven work: Recruiting done properly: structured, skill-based, documented, and fair
Compensation: Salary is discussed transparently during the process, benchmarked against market data. No blanket figures
without basis. If this is relevant for you upfront, mention it in your application, we'll address it directly.
Our Hiring Process
We screen based on skills, not credentials. Here is what to expect:
Application review: A person reads every application, no automated filtering
Short intro call (20–30 min): Context, fit, mutual questions
Skills-based interview (60 min): Structured, competency-specific, with documented assessment
Optional: work sample or personality test: Role-relevant, time-boxed, focused on a real scenario
Final conversation + decision: Transparent feedback regardless of outcome
We aim to respond within 5 business days. If timelines shift, we communicate proactively.

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale.

More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency.

Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.
Company Operating Rhythm
At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.
Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.
Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.
The Opportunity
As a Senior Technical Recruiter, you'll own full-cycle recruiting for our most complex and high-impact engineering roles — spanning customer-facing and core platform teams — across both US and international markets. You'll help Deepgram scale by building pipelines for AI-native technical talent across geographies, navigating regional market dynamics, and partnering closely with the team on compliant, scalable hiring practices.
This role requires fluency in how AI products are built and deployed, strong judgment on technical bar, and a systems-level view of recruiting — not just within one market, but across time zones, cultures, and the specialized talent communities that define the frontier of voice AI and applied machine learning.

Own full-cycle recruiting for senior and hard-to-fill technical roles across Research, Engineering, and Product teams.
Lead global recruiting efforts across multiple regions (e.g. US, EMEA, APAC), including sourcing, interviewing, and closing candidates in diverse markets.
Partner with hiring managers to define role scope, leveling, and interview plans that account for both business needs and regional talent realities.
Build proactive sourcing strategies for niche and senior-level technical talent in the US and abroad.
Evaluate candidates for technical depth, impact, and alignment with Deepgram’s values across different cultural and regional contexts.
Deliver a high-quality candidate experience across time zones through clear communication, thoughtful process design, and operational rigor.
Use data and funnel metrics to diagnose issues, improve signal quality, and increase hiring velocity globally.
Collaborate with People Ops, Legal, and Finance to support compliant global hiring (employment models, offers, and regional considerations).
Help evolve recruiting infrastructure, tools, and interview practices to support international scale.

Hands-on experience leading global expansion efforts, including hiring across multiple countries or regions.
Experience recruiting for at least two of the following domains: Customer Engineering / Solutions Engineering, Backend / Platform Infrastructure, Product Engineering, or Developer-facing roles.
Strong technical literacy — you don't need to code, but you should understand how modern software systems, APIs, and customer-integrated technical products are built. We are an AI-native company and believe in the future of these products.
Proven ability to source and close senior-level and highly specialized technical talent in competitive, international markets, particularly for roles that sit at the intersection of technical depth and customer impact.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and helping teams sharpen what "good" looks like across different regions and customer segments.
Excellent stakeholder management skills and the confidence to push back when needed — especially when balancing speed-to-hire with bar integrity for customer-critical roles.
A builder's mindset: you care about process quality, signal, and long-term scalability, not just filling seats.

Experience recruiting for AI-native, AI-first, or applied AI companies
Deep familiarity with AI/ML systems, LLMs, real-time inference, or data-intensive infrastructure — enough to hold a credible conversation with the engineers you're hiring.
Experience supporting distributed, remote-first teams building AI products across time zones and geographies.

Job Description
We build the operating system for renewables: more than 10 GW across 8,000+ plants run on the Amperecloud Platform. Growing that requires energy expertise, and it requires exceptional people. Finding them, developing them and keeping them is what this role exists for.
As
Talent Partner (m/f/d) you work directly with our founders. You own everything talent: who we hire, how we assess, how people grow, and the culture all of it runs on.
Lead: Frederik (CEO) & Florian Strunck (COO)
Contract type: Full-time, permanent
Start : October/November
Location: Berlin

The focus is singular: talent density and the culture that sustains it. You make sure the few people we hire are exceptional, that our strong people stay and grow, and that our values remain a working standard rather than a poster.
Within that focus, you are the third voice beside the founders on people decisions: who we hire, who we promote, who we bet on, when we part ways. You read people precisely, see early where they are heading, and say it out loud in the room where it counts. No process replaces that; ours is built to support it.
The same logic extends beyond the founders: to our decision-makers you are an advisor, not an order-taker. You read the talent market and tell them what their plans will cost, you sharpen how we present ourselves to candidates, and you build pipelines for the roles we will need before we need them.
You will not start from zero. Over the past year we built our People Guild: values translated into observable behaviors, a leveling framework with Berlin salary bands, structured interviews with an independent bar raiser who holds a veto, a lean feedback cycle. You inherit the engine mid-build, documented, with deadlines and founder sponsorship. You finish it, run it, and make it yours.

Hiring: Full-cycle recruiting for few, senior, often technical roles. Outbound-first: you map markets and build pipelines from scratch rather than waiting for applications. You run the culture screen as the first interview of every process and protect the hiring bar, founders included.
Culture: Our ADEPT values as a working rubric. Every interview, feedback cycle and promotion scores against it, and you keep it sharp.
Development and retention: Leveling, salary bands, a semi-annual feedback cycle, promotion rounds, VSOP administration, retention bets on key people.
Tooling and automation: Our ATS contract ends next year; you pick and roll out its successor. You build automations across our ATS, Notion and Humaans so manual work keeps shrinking and your time keeps moving toward talent and culture.

People decisions at a 40-person company are company decisions, and you make them with the founders
VSOP participation like everyone here: if the Operating System for Renewables becomes what we are building, that stake is meaningful
Salary band shared in the first conversation, not after four rounds

s.h: Development: educational leave, a steep curve by design
s.t:
Team & culture: regular offsites
Mobility & health: JobRad, up to 100% Deutschlandticket subsidy, pension plan, Wellpass/Urban Sports, childcare subsidies

Full-cycle recruiting experience from high-paced environments: a high-growth startup or scaleup, the talent team of a VC or PE firm, or a top search firm, including senior and engineering searches you sourced and closed yourself. Years matter less than evidence: show us numbers (pass-through rates, offer-accept rate, quality of hire after 12 months).
AI as your default way of working, not a tool you tried. You use LLMs daily and can walk us through real workflows you built: sourcing and market mapping, structured screening support, scorecard synthesis, drafting at scale. In the interview, you will show us one, live.
Automation literacy: You have connected tools via APIs or no-code (Apps Script, Zapier/Make/n8n or similar) to kill manual work. You read API docs without flinching. You do not need to be an engineer; you need to think like one about repetitive tasks.
Evidence-based assessment: You run structured interviews and can defend a hire or no-hire with observations, not impressions. A track record of calls that aged well: hires that outperformed, hard cases you named early.
German employment law working knowledge: contracts, terminations, fixed terms, works-council-free environments. Enough to know when you need a lawyer, and when you do not.
Data fluency: strong Sheets/Excel, comfortable owning funnel and retention metrics end to end; SQL basics a plus.
German (C1+) and English fluent. Our contracts are German, our company language is English.
First-principles thinker who writes things down. Default output

Exactly the one you will later run: culture screen, skill assessment with a live case (bring your AI workflows), founder final.
